title: Foundry standing-grants policy (.foundry/permissions.yaml)
description: feat-foundry-authorization-standing-grants-as-policy (AC-SGP-1). One workspace-owned file the operator edits and the agent never does (see cli/permission-floor.json's deny rules on this path): each grant is `automatic` (proceed once its preconditions are verified) or `approval_required` (surface one blocker line naming the grant). `scripts/foundry-permissions-compile.py` compiles this into the native `permissions.allow`/`permissions.ask` rule sets `.claude/settings.json` already enforces -- no policy engine of our own.

schema_version.description: The one schema_version this build understands.

grants.description: Duplicate `id`s are refused by the compiler (AC-SGP-1); a JSON Schema `uniqueItems` cannot express uniqueness over a single subfield, so this is enforced structurally in scripts/foundry-permissions-compile.py.

id.description: A slug -- the identifier surfaced in a report line or a blocker line.

tool.description: The native Claude Code tool this grant's compiled rule gates.

pattern.description: The native rule's parenthesised body -- the compiled rule is exactly `<tool>(<pattern>)`.

mode.description: `automatic`: proceed once every listed precondition has been verified by command. `approval_required`: one blocker line naming this grant's `id`.

preconditions.description: Closed set (AC-SGP-1). Machine enforcement of these is out of scope for this atom -- the agent verifies each by command and records having done so.

note.description: Free-text operator note; never consulted for enforcement.
